summary: First iteration testing of Onanar. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed (auth, opportunities list/search/filter, profile, match scoring, saves CRUD, admin stats, admin CRUD, digest, impact). Frontend: All critical UI flows verified end-to-end: landing, directory (46 seeded opps, search 'residency'→5 cards), artist login, save opportunity, tracker (item appears with status select), opportunity detail (title, source link, match summary present), admin login redirects to /admin with stat cards populated (stat-total=46), digest generator produces 2219-char whatsapp text and switches tabs, impact save computes time_saved=8 & pct=66.7% correctly, signup redirects to /profile, artist blocked from /admin (redirect to /), logged-out user redirected from /tracker to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown handlers — consider lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; production must set explicit origins in .env.
admin_patch accepts raw dict and only whitelists 'verified' and 'status' — reasonable, but a Pydantic model would be cleaner and self-documenting.

compute_match returns match_summary via reasons[:4] + capitalize — capitalize() on a joined string only capitalises first letter and lowercases the rest, which can distort discipline names (e.g., 'Visual Arts' → 'Visual arts'). Cosmetic.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (mentioned in playbook_testing_instructions). Not required by feature list but flagged for security posture.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@onanar.in / admin123; Artist: artist@test.in / artist123 (auto-created via /auth/register if absent).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Backend test creates TEST_ prefixed users/opportunities and deletes them within the same test. Impact PUT modifies the singleton impact doc (hours_before=10, hours_after=3) at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is stable and covers all major flows in ~4s. If retesting after changes to compute_match or admin routes, run: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend digest-output is a <textarea>, use page.input_value() (not inner_text). Signup redirect target is /profile; login redirect is /opportunities (artist) or /admin (admin). Impact PUT leaves hours_before=10, hours_after=3 in DB after tests.
